exposure: None beyond audit subject matter: D10 reads README.md and docs/*.md as the measured corpus; the export had audit register/backlog/release notes stripped. The integration's own GitHub issues/PRs were not read; GitHub was queried only for the three third-party dependency repos and the codeowner account endpoint.

findings.title: No automation example anywhere in the shipped documentation (docs-examples, gold)
findings.claim: Zero automation examples exist across README.md and all 8 docs/*.md files (case-insensitive regex 'service:\s*heatpump_optimizer\.|action:\s*-\s*service'), even though the docs direct users to build automations (configuration.md:55, plan-v4.0.0-program.md:1241) without ever showing one.
findings.mechanism: The Services sections document all 11 actions as tables (README:428-457, configuration.md:533-641) but no worked automation: YAML exists anywhere in the corpus; the gold docs-examples rule ('at least one usable automation example exercising integration services/entities') is unmet.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out shared box during the eleven-dimension audit; grep counts are contention-immune; load1 recorded at run end

findings.instrumented_symbol: services.yaml:actions (11 registered actions) vs README.md+docs/*.md corpus

perturbation.change: HPO_DOC_PERTURB_FILE=tools/audit/round2/D10/C/perturb_automation_example.md python3 tools/audit/round2/D10/C/doc_coverage.py (adds one worked heatpump_optimizer.set_mode automation to the corpus; the equivalent edit in README '## Services' is the production fix)
